# Carrow & Harcourt

- [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) — Spouse of — [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) — husband and wife · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREY SHUTTERS P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discusses her upcoming wedding plans and guest list with Mrs. Sowerby and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). Visitors arrive at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to celebrate, including [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), Mother [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), and [Reverend Ez](../character/ezra.md). After visiting Obed's grave in solitude, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) takes a walk and meets Hugh on the eve of their wedding.
